source_name: Ripple issue-linked change dataset (record instance-00010; used for candidate discovery and cross-check only)
issue_text:
Snapshot issues when using ibiblio resolver when m2compatible is false

I changed the java.net resolver to use the maven2 of download.java.net and added m2compatible and usepoms=true. Now it does not fail with NPE.

Ivy 2.0.0 is used with snapshot versions. The reporter's resolver configuration includes an ibiblio resolver with m2compatible/usepoms enabled and a java.net resolver using a custom artifact pattern. A snapshot dependency cannot be resolved and Ivy reports an IndexOutOfBoundsException in IBiblioResolver.findSnapshotVersion.

Cleaning: retained the Jira summary and the opening problem statement and technical reproduction from the original Jira description; omitted quoted mailing-list headers, contact addresses, and follow-up discussion. The source description is preserved by ASF Jira; this cleaned request is not represented as a verbatim transcript.
